simple.meaning: נָשָׂא (nâsâʼ) appears 654 times in the Hebrew Scriptures as a person-name in the Hebrew text.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, beginning at Genesis 4:13. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as righteousness, city, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָשָׂא (H5375) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows נָשָׂא through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: נָשָׂא (nâsâʼ) / H5375 is tracked through Genesis 4:13, Genesis 7:17, Genesis 13:6, Genesis 13:10. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.full: H5375. nasa or nasah נְשָׂא verb lift, take, carry (compare Biblical Hebrew; rare in Aramaic; see נְסָא נְסִי, ChWB, NHWB); — Pe`al Perfect 3masculine singular ׳נ Dan 2:35 carry away (of wind, with accusative of thing); Imperative masculine singular שֵׂא Ezra 5:15 take (accusative vessels).
